name: Iguanas Free Concert
description: Enjoy a relaxed evening with a blend of alt-pop and lo-fi psychedelia from Iguanas at this free show—a perfect start to the weekend.
longDescription:
On May 21, 2026, the Casa da Música Café hosts a free concert featuring Iguanas. This musical act is known for its distinctive sound, which combines elements of alternative pop with lo-fi psychedelic influences. The performance offers an opportunity to hear their unique blend of genres in a live setting.

Attendees can anticipate a relaxed atmosphere for this evening performance. The Casa da Música Café provides an intimate setting, suitable for enjoying live music. The event is designed for those seeking a casual cultural experience as the week draws to a close.

Admission to the Iguanas concert is free, and no tickets are required. The Casa da Música is located near the Carolina Michaelis metro station, a short walk from the venue. The café is situated within the main Casa da Música building.
